open_items: Real scope (see HANDOFF.md): production catalog 46605 location rows / 43112 sources / 35110881225 registered bytes; 3531 candidate groups; logical_duplicate_bytes_upper_bound=7804167537 (22.2% of registered bytes); physical_allocated_bytes=7804167537; verified_duplicate_bytes=158223532; deleted_bytes=0.
Only 3 of 3531 groups were actually re-read (max-groups=3, 316447064 bytes over 6 files); the other 3528 groups are metadata-level upper bound only and were never opened.

Report lists 510 of 3531 groups: detail_rows=1039/5000, dropped_groups_by_row_cap=1043, dropped_groups_by_size_cap=1978, dropped_groups_total=3021, report_bytes=1046597/1048576; counts.duplicate_groups_full=3531 keeps the full-population figure.
limits_hit contains scope caps (max_groups, detail_rows, report_bytes); status stays succeeded because deadline and read_bytes were never hit.
Full confirmation of the remaining groups requires an explicit higher --max-groups with proportionally more read volume and runtime.
hardlink and ACL integration assertions skip on platforms without os.link or icacls; both passed on this machine.
Whether to implement production dedup, and under which option, is MAIN's decision based on the measured benefit and reference compatibility; this lane provides no deletion list and no migration plan.
